title: Change
description: What a later capture of a primary source showed about a row the register had already published, or a correction a person made to one, citing the evidence. The published row stays exactly as published, unless a person's correction moves one of its facts; then this row keeps what the fact was (CHARTER Vow V; INVARIANTS §14). The adapter (src/adapters/house-fd/build.py) writes one where a capture later than the one a row was read from shows it otherwise; tools/correct.py writes a person's correction. Either way the bytes of the capture it cites are kept in data/captures/sha256/, named by their SHA-256, so the change can be checked from the repository alone once the source serves something else. A change row never changes and is never removed: data/changes.ndjson only grows at its end. It carries the frame, because a change row names a person's row and may be read without the page.

id.description: ch:<change>:<row id>[:<field>]:<the capture's retrieved_at>. One change per row, kind, field and capture.

row_id.description: The id of the published row the change is about.

rows.description: Which of the register's files holds that row.

change.description: not listed: the capture does not list the row (the Clerk's roster no longer lists the officeholder, or the index the filing); the source does not say why. listed again: a later capture lists a row an earlier one did not. read otherwise: the capture, as the register reads it, gives one of the row's facts another value (`field`, `was`, `now`); the row keeps the value it was published with. replaced: the source serves other bytes for a filing's document, and they read otherwise; the rows read from the first bytes are kept as published. corrected: a person moved one of the row's facts, or recorded that it stands, citing the evidence (`because`, `kind`, `decided_by`, `decided_at`).

field.description: The fact the change is about, as a path into the row (filed_at, officeholder_id, source.content_hash). On read otherwise, replaced and corrected.

was.description: The value the published row carries for the field; for a correction, the value it carried before.

now.description: The value the capture gives, or the value a correction sets. Equal to `was` when the source reads as published again, or when a person records that the published value stands.

kind.description: A correction's kind: the source now states the fact otherwise (source), or the register read or joined it wrongly (register).

because.description: A correction's reason, in one sentence, naming what the evidence shows.

decided_by.description: Who made the correction, by role.

decided_at.description: When the correction was made, UTC.

before.description: When the register last built from a capture of the same source before this one, UTC. The change fell between the two reads; the register does not know when, or why.

capture.description: The capture that shows the change, or the evidence a correction cites: where it was read, when (UTC), and the SHA-256 of the bytes, which the register keeps at data/captures/sha256/<content_hash> with the capture's own extension.

build.description: The build the row was first sealed in, as tools/seal.py stamps it.

frame.const: Presence in the register is not evidence of wrongdoing.
frame.description: The register's frame, on the row, because the row can travel without the page.

examples.frame: Presence in the register is not evidence of wrongdoing.
Presence in the register is not evidence of wrongdoing.
